Build a survey design from DHS, MICS or STEPS microdata

Source: R/design_helpers.R
design_helpers.Rd

Thin wrappers around survey::svydesign() that use each programme's standard variable names, so the design (clusters, strata, weights) is specified correctly in one line.

Usage

dhs_design(
  data,
  psu = "v021",
  strata = "v023",
  weight = "v005",
  weight_scale = 1e+06,
  ...
)

mics_design(
  data,
  weight,
  psu = "HH1",
  strata = "stratum",
  weight_scale = 1,
  ...
)

steps_design(
  data,
  weight,
  psu = "psu",
  strata = "stratum",
  weight_scale = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data frame of survey microdata.

psu, strata, weight

Names of the cluster, stratum and weight columns. Set strata = NULL for an unstratified design.

weight_scale

Number the weight is divided by (1e6 for raw DHS weights; 1 if the weight has already been rescaled).

...

Further arguments passed to survey::svydesign().

Value

A survey.design2 object.

Details

  • DHS: the Guide to DHS Statistics identifies the primary sampling unit as v021 (hv021/mv021 in household and men's files), the strata as v023 (hv023/mv023) and the weight as v005 (hv005/mv005) divided by 1,000,000. Check the survey report (Appendix A) where strata were not consistently defined.

  • MICS: clusters are HH1 and strata stratum; the weight depends on the file (hhweight, wmweight, mnweight, chweight, fsweight), so it must be given.

  • STEPS: clusters are usually psu and strata stratum; the weight depends on the step analysed (wstep1, wstep2, wstep3), so it must be given. A design built with the stepssurvey package can be passed to SurveyNCD functions directly instead.

All three set nest = TRUE, because cluster numbers are typically reused across strata, and drop rows with a missing or non-positive weight with a message.

References

ICF. Guide to DHS Statistics: Analyzing DHS data. https://dhsprogram.com/data/Guide-to-DHS-Statistics/Analyzing_DHS_Data.htm

Examples

# A toy individual-recode extract with DHS variable names
set.seed(1)
ir <- data.frame(
  v021 = rep(1:20, each = 10),
  v023 = rep(1:4, each = 50),
  v005 = round(runif(200, 5e5, 2e6)),
  htn  = rbinom(200, 1, 0.2)
)
des <- dhs_design(ir)
survey_prevalence(des, "htn")
#>   indicator   n  estimate         se     lower     upper    deff
#> 1       htn 200 0.1850791 0.03221461 0.1261875 0.2631776 1.36926

# MICS and STEPS: same idea, weight column chosen for the file or step
names(ir) <- c("HH1", "stratum", "wmweight", "htn")
ir$wmweight <- ir$wmweight / 1e6
mics_design(ir, weight = "wmweight")
#> Stratified 1 - level Cluster Sampling design (with replacement)
#> With (20) clusters.
#> survey::svydesign(ids = stats::as.formula(paste0("~`", psu, "`")), 
#>     strata = if (is.null(strata)) NULL else stats::as.formula(paste0("~`", 
#>         strata, "`")), weights = ~.surveyncd_weight, data = data, 
#>     nest = TRUE, ...)
